lines.text: Welcome to Astravale, adventurer! Ready for your entrance exam?

Ten slimes have made a home beneath our village well.
Head to the well and press E to descend.

Slay all ten, then climb the ladder back and report to me.
I'll give you coins, experience, and a fine weapon for your class.

Keep your weapon ready... and try not to die!
Your first quest: slay 10 slimes beneath the well.
